blocks.text: Day 3 · A visit to an Emberá village on the Chagres River, in an exceptional natural setting: the Emberá, originally from the Darién, still live in their traditional homes and share their dances, music and songs, their use of plants and flowers as natural medicine, and the way they build their houses. Late in the afternoon, a flight from Albrook domestic airport to David, capital of Chiriquí province, and transfer to your hotel in Boquete. Overnight at La Casa de la Abuela. (B)
